title: Constrained 10-Layer Refinement with Reduced Perturbation
scientific_hypothesis: Reducing thickness perturbation bounds to ±5 nm during optimization will restrict search to the immediate basin of attraction around the iteration_05 best configuration (score 0.9977), preventing the volatility that caused regression to 0.9922 in iteration_11.
design_principle: Local refinement with bounded step sizes preserves the superior configuration found in round 2 while allowing fine-tuning. Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:290861773:s2chunk:290861773:38501:40208:f4813fe9b5ee3e0b supports thickness optimization over analytical quarter-wave solutions for broadband requirements.
proposed_topology: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Si (10 finite layers, alternating high-low starting with Ta2O5)
soft_objectives: minimize mean reflectance over 1260-1360 nm band
minimize mean reflectance over 1530-1565 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm
materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method thickness optimization for multi-band AR coatings
Local search with bounded perturbations for refinement of known good configurations
expected_advantages: Reduced search volatility compared to iteration_11
Preservation of iteration_05 best configuration characteristics
known_risks: May converge to local optimum if global structure needs larger changes
±5 nm bounds may be too restrictive if iteration_05 configuration is not in optimal basin
execution_request_english: Optimize a 10-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 anti-reflection coating on silicon substrate for dual-band operation at 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm. Stack topology: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Si (10 finite layers, alternating starting with high-index Ta2O5). Initialize all layer thicknesses from iteration_05 best candidate: [56.0, 110.0, 176.0, 172.0, 88.0, 117.0, 111.0, 250.0, 112.0, 45.0] nm. Apply gradient-based thickness optimization with perturbation bounds restricted to ±5 nm per layer per iteration. Thickness constraints: 20-400 nm per layer. Incidence: 0 deg, unpolarized. Objective: minimize weighted mean reflectance across both bands equally, report transmittance into Si. Evaluate candidates by target_score (reflectance minimization), robustness_score, and thicknesses_nm outputs. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 1260-1360 nm, 1530-1565 nm. soft objectives: low average reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band; low average reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflection in the specified bands. manufacturing constraints: maximum 12 layers; individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm; materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Reduced thickness perturbation bounds from unconstrained to ±5 nm per feedback directive addressing search space volatility that caused score regression from 0.9977 to 0.9922. Initialization preserved from iteration_05 best candidate.
